glosses: to cause (to set off an event or action)
to make (to force or be the cause of someone doing something)

examples.text: Mogła się troskać, fra­sować, że się jakoś uspokoić nie umie, ale spowodować go do natychmiastowego posłuchu nie mogła.
examples.translation: She could be concerned and worried that he couldn't calm down, but she couldn't make him listen immediately.
examples.english: She could be concerned and worried that he couldn't calm down, but she couldn't make him listen immediately.

examples.text: Ciągłe napady spowodowały Bolesława, że się znowu na Pomorze z wojskiem wybrał.
examples.translation: The constant attacks made Bolesław to go to Pomerania with his army again.
examples.english: The constant attacks made Bolesław to go to Pomerania with his army again.

examples.text: Wszystkie zabiegi, jakie czyniono później po województwach, aby szlachtę spowodować do wiązania się w konfederacją, rozbiły się najzu­pełniej o jej opór stanowczy.
examples.translation: All the efforts that were later made in the voivodeships to make the nobility join the confederation were completely ruined by their determined resistance.
examples.english: All the efforts that were later made in the voivodeships to make the nobility join the confederation were completely ruined by their determined resistance.

examples.text: Co was spowodowało osiąść na roli?
examples.translation: What made you to settle down in a field?
examples.english: What made you to settle down in a field?

examples.text: Chodziło już teraz nie tyle o to, aby popierać dobre chęci Aleksandra, ile o to, aby spowodować go do wypełnienia jego zobowiązań.
examples.translation: The point now was not so much to support Alexander's good intentions as to make him to fulfill his obligations.
examples.english: The point now was not so much to support Alexander's good intentions as to make him to fulfill his obligations.

examples.text: Niektóre leki psychotropowe mogą spowodować kłopoty z erekcją.

glosses: устар. потянуть; начать тянуть, тащить что-либо
вызвать, подстрекнуть кого-либо на какие-либо действия

examples.text: «Так как фильм носит «высокопровокативный характер» по заключению экспертов, то его демонстрация может с высокой степенью вероятности спровоцировать опасные последствия для социальной стабильности и гражданского мира в стране.
